headline: Isa, you're great! The index she created with the Housing Law to protect rental prices soars to 2.56%, its all-time high
summary: The rent index created under Spain's Housing Law reached 2.56%, its all-time high. Since the law took effect, landlords must use this index instead of the 4.9% CPI.
why: Rent-control rules tied to a national index directly set the maximum annual rent increases on many Spanish leases. Changes in the index affect landlord income and rental-housing returns.
